Dsos.ddl:
CREATE TABLE "Dsos" (
	name VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	user_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	id UUID DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_dso_user_id UNIQUE (user_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

appointment_sync_logs.ddl:
CREATE TABLE appointment_sync_logs (
	clinic_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	pat_id UUID, 
	appointment_id UUID, 
	inbound_event_id UUID, 
	direction sync_direction_enum NOT NULL, 
	appointment_status VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	sync_status sync_status_enum DEFAULT 'QUEUED' NOT NULL, 
	change_key VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	event_id VARCHAR, 
	contact_id VARCHAR, 
	apt_num INTEGER, 
	patient_name VARCHAR, 
	patient_name_search VARCHAR, 
	reason VARCHAR, 
	attempt_count INTEGER DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	operation VARCHAR, 
	payload TEXT, 
	failure_source sync_failure_source_enum DEFAULT 'NONE' NOT NULL, 
	counts_toward_usage BOOLEAN DEFAULT 'false' NOT NULL, 
	is_billable BOOLEAN DEFAULT 'false' NOT NULL, 
	billing_processed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	started_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	completed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	id UUID DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_appointment_sync_logs_change_key UNIQUE (change_key), 
	FOREIGN KEY(clinic_id) REFERENCES registered_clinics (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(pat_id) REFERENCES patients (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(appointment_id) REFERENCES appointments (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, 
	FOREIGN KEY(inbound_event_id) REFERENCES inbound_events (id) ON DELETE SET NULL
)
indexes: CREATE INDEX ix_sync_logs_clinic_started_id ON appointment_sync_logs (clinic_id, started_at, id)
CREATE INDEX ix_sync_logs_clinic_status_started_at ON appointment_sync_logs (clinic_id, sync_status, started_at, id)
CREATE INDEX ix_sync_logs_started_id ON appointment_sync_logs (started_at, id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_appointment_sync_logs_id ON appointment_sync_logs (id)

appointments.ddl:
CREATE TABLE appointments (
	"AptNum" INTEGER, 
	event_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	previous_status VARCHAR, 
	status_changed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	start_time VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	end_time VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	date VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	calendar_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	commslog_done BOOLEAN DEFAULT 'false' NOT NULL, 
	popups_done BOOLEAN DEFAULT 'false' NOT NULL, 
	clinic_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	pat_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	id UUID DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT "uq_clinic_AptNum" UNIQUE (clinic_id, "AptNum"),

billing_subscriptions.ddl:
CREATE TABLE billing_subscriptions (
	scope_type scope_type_enum NOT NULL, 
	dso_id UUID, 
	clinic_id UUID, 
	wallet_id UUID, 
	status subscription_status_enum DEFAULT 'TRAILING' NOT NULL, 
	billing_cycle "Billing_cycle_enum" DEFAULT 'MONTHLY' NOT NULL, 
	payment_provider payment_provider_enum DEFAULT 'STRIPE' NOT NULL, 
	plan_code billing_plan_code_enum NOT NULL, 
	base_price_minor BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	currency VARCHAR DEFAULT 'USD' NOT NULL, 
	included_sync_threshold INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	external_subscription_id VARCHAR, 
	current_period_start TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	current_period_end TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	next_billing_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	canceled_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	id UUID DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(dso_id) REFERENCES "Dsos" (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(clinic_id) REFERENCES registered_clinics (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(wallet_id) REFERENCES wallets (id) ON DELETE SET NULL
)
indexes: CREATE INDEX ix_billing_subscriptions_clinic_status ON billing_subscriptions (clinic_id, status)
CREATE INDEX ix_billing_subscriptions_dso_status ON billing_subscriptions (dso_id, status)
CREATE INDEX ix_billing_subscriptions_scope_status ON billing_subscriptions (scope_type, status)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_billing_subscriptions_id ON billing_subscriptions (id)

daily_sync_usage_summaries.ddl:
CREATE TABLE daily_sync_usage_summaries (
	dso_id UUID, 
	clinic_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	usage_date DATE NOT NULL, 
	total_sync_attempts INTEGER DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	successful_syncs INTEGER DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	customer_configuration_failures INTEGER DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	open_dental_failures INTEGER DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	crm_failures INTEGER DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	webhook_failures INTEGER DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	internal_failures INTEGER DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	unknown_failures INTEGER DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	counted_usage_units INTEGER DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	included_units_applied INTEGER DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	billable_overage_units INTEGER DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	aggregation_status daily_sync_aggregation_status_enum DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL, 
	usage_event_id UUID, 
	processed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	id UUID DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_daily_sync_usage_clinic_date UNIQUE (clinic_id, usage_date), 
	FOREIGN KEY(dso_id) REFERENCES "Dsos" (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, 
	FOREIGN KEY(clinic_id) REFERENCES registered_clinics (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(usage_event_id) REFERENCES usage_events (id) ON DELETE SET NULL
)
indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_daily_sync_usage_summaries_id ON daily_sync_usage_summaries (id)

CREATE TABLE registered_clinics (
	crm_type VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	clinic_name VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	clinic_number INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	clinic_timezone VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	od_developer_key VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	od_customer_key VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	crm_api_key VARCHAR NOT NULL,

	calendar_id VARCHAR NOT NULL,
